evidence_items.locator: Section How Does Adoption of Generative AI Compare with That of Other Technologies?
evidence_items.explanation: The representative survey reports generative-AI adoption among 39.4% of US adults aged 18–64, with 28.1% of employed respondents reporting work use. This establishes mass uptake within approximately twenty months of the post; the measure does not imply that all users used AI daily.

receipt.public_excerpt: the European Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) enters into force.

evidence_items.explanation: The EU-wide framework creates obligations covering AI uses and general-purpose models, demonstrating a substantial institutional response. Entry into force is distinct from the later application dates of individual requirements.

Only 18% of US adults reported ever using ChatGPT in July 2023. This limits claims of immediate or universal uptake, but covers one product at an earlier date and does not negate broader societal effects.
